facts.text: I am Erwin Pena.
Thomas Wolff is the COO.
Jeff Palumbo is involved in the email thread.
Mark B. Newbauer is the President/Founder.
Thomas Wolff provided a phone number of (707) 682-9473.
Thomas Wolff provided an email address of cs@mcapmedia.com.
Thomas Wolff provided an email address of tw@mcapmedia.com.
Thomas Wolff provided the website https://www.mcapmediawire.com.
Mcap MediaWire has a Linktree handle of @McapMediaWire.
The project is to increase Mcap network endpoints together with a monetization option.
Project A is named THE MICRO CAP OBSERVER – Weekly Newsletter for public listed Micro Cap Corporation.
The planned domain name for THE MICRO CAP OBSERVER is http://themicrocapobserver.com/.
The monthly software license cost for THE MICRO CAP OBSERVER is USD 150.00 for 1 site down to USD 125.00 for bulk sites.
Monetization for THE MICRO CAP OBSERVER includes banner/advertisements sold by Mcap, Google Ads, and other third-party ad sellers.
Project B is named Bulk WordPress News Sites.
Project B plans 5 sites for every 30 days, 20 sites for the next 120 days, and 60 sites for the next 12 months.
The planned principal domain for Project B is http://www.mcapmediagroup.com/.
Project B uses subdomains under http://www.mcapmediagroup.com/ for each site.
An example Project B site is 24/7 Business Reporter at 247businessreporter.com.
Project B sites will use the same template but different logos and colors.
Project B is described as an import/export of steady RSS feed content starting with Mcap and also offering bulk content delivery from third-party wire services or marketing/IR firms.
Project B sites are planned to accept multimedia content delivered with RSS feed to ARGUS Journal with a social media share gadget.
The bulk price per site development for Project B is USD 250.00 including initial integration of RSS feed import/export with 5 minutes updates.
If 5 sites monthly are agreed for the next 12 months, the Project B price per site is planned to be reduced to $225.00.
Additional host fees for Project B may be smaller than 300 to 400 USD monthly for all sites.
Any additional cost from the web developer is described as $15.00 per hour.
Monetization for Project B includes banner/advertisements sold by Mcap, Google Ads, and other third-party ad sellers.
Project C is closing a network partnership with COMTEXT to increase syndication of the RSS feed.
The cost per submission for Project C is around $26.00.
Project C includes important syndicate endpoints where COMTEX is exclusive.
There are around 200 registered clients in the publicly listed micro cap space.
Almost all of the 200 registered clients are on OTC.
There is a market niche called NASDAQ and NYSE Nano and Micro Caps.
There is a planned conference with the software licenser to discuss potential advertisement spaces.
The weekly planned newsletter will include OTC Pinks, OTCQB, NASDAG, and NYSE sections.
The weekly planned newsletter will have around 10 to 20 subcategories per category.
There is an option to get Google Ads on the site with a signed referral program with the software group.
The software group has more than 100 online and printed newsletters on their server.
The license fee for the weekly planned newsletter is 150 monthly down to 125 if 5+ licenses are purchased.
Example site miningnewsnorth.com is described as showing ads on the right part.
Example site metaltechnews.com is described as showing ads on the right site.
